summary: Tested the 18 supplier presets end to end. Backend: test_connectors.py (mocked) plus test_store_regression.py gave 43/43 PASS. The new test_supplier_integrations.py gave 17/18 PASS. Checked: exactly 18 presets; BlackHatWorld is CONFIGURATION_ERROR with a SECURITY_REVIEW note; Prmast and Samayra are NEEDS_REVIEW; the other 15 are NOT_CONNECTED; no credential_enc and no plain key in responses (only key_masked). Connecting with a fake key against real hosts: AIVaultHub, Canboso and StoreGPTPlus returned AUTH_FAILED (HTTP 401) without echoing the key. Acczone returned ok:true CONNECTED with 5 real products, because its endpoint does not check the key. BlackHatWorld gave CONFIGURATION_ERROR and no request was sent. Revoke puts each supplier back to its original status. Sync without a key gives 400, a forced lock gives 409, an unknown id gives 404, a short key gives 422. Exchange rates sanitize bad and negative values. Preview with fixed_markup 3000 and rounding 100 gives 16000 and 35500; percent 10 with rounding 500 gives 14500 and 36000. Import creates a draft SUPPLIER_API product with 2 price_locked variants. A second import gives 'already imported'. After publishing, the public list and detail pages contain no supplier_cost or supplier_currency. A customer_service user gets 403 and an anonymous user gets 401. Manual product create still works. /admin/suppliers excludes presets. Frontend (1920 desktop): the integrations page shows 8 metrics and 18 cards with correct badges; the Connect dialog has a single API key field; Connect & Test shows an AUTH_FAILED result panel; the card shows the masked key; Revoke resets the card. The catalogue page works: rates card save, search with empty state, supplier filter with 19 options, row selection, pricing bar, preview (16,000 Ks and 35,500 Ks), Import as draft (toast 'Imported 1 as DRAFT'), row disabled with an 'Imported → edit' link to the product editor. The custom suppliers page loads. No page errors. One real data-integrity bug found (below).

critical.issue: Saving an imported preset product in the Products editor (the documented way to publish) removes supplier_variant_key and supplier_currency from every variant. VariantIn does not declare these fields, and SUPPLIER_OWNED only keeps supplier_cost, supplier_stock and last_synced_at. Reproduced: after the PUT, variants have supplier_variant_key None and None (should be '0' and '1'). Effect: on the next sync, suppliers.apply_to_variant falls back to n['cost'] (the first tier cost) for every variant, so the 3-month plan gets the 1-month cost. Fix: add 'supplier_variant_key' and 'supplier_currency' to SUPPLIER_OWNED (copy them from prev) or add them to VariantIn.

minor.issue: Acczone /getServices answers 200 with any key, so a fake key gives ok:true, auth:'verified' and status CONNECTED. The 'API authentication: Verified' text in the UI is misleading for presets whose endpoint is public. Consider wording such as 'request succeeded (supplier does not validate the key on this endpoint)', or a per-preset flag.

The check-then-update on linked_product_id is not atomic. Two concurrent imports of the same item can create duplicate products. Use find_one_and_update with {linked_product_id: null} as a claim before inserting.

The variant stock_status is always 'in_stock' even when the supplier product has stock_status out_of_stock or stock 0. supplier_stock falls back to 999 when stock is None, so items with 'unknown' stock show as available.
Does not restrict supplier_product_id to preset suppliers (catalogue GET does). It also silently skips unknown ids instead of reporting an error.
AUTH_FAILED and CONFIGURATION_ERROR are retried 3 times with backoff sleeps. Non-transient errors should not be retried, because a bad key makes the user wait several seconds.
This counts supplier_products (catalogue items), not imported local products. The label 'Imported products' is misleading; call it 'Catalogue items'.

issues: The error panel shows the code twice ('AUTH_FAILED' then 'AUTH_FAILED: HTTP 401'). Show a friendly message instead, e.g. 'Invalid API key (HTTP 401)'.
The page title is 'Supplier integrations', the same as the preset page. Rename it to 'Custom suppliers' to match the sidebar.
Content is capped at about 1330px and left-aligned, which leaves a large empty area on the right. This is optional.
The rounding, local category and brand filter selects, and the Add currency button, have no data-testid.

action_items: HIGH: keep supplier_variant_key and supplier_currency when a product is saved via PUT /admin/products/{pid} (add them to SUPPLIER_OWNED in routes_admin.build_product). Then re-run test_supplier_integrations.py::TestCatalogue::test_edit_imported_product_keeps_variant_key.
Make the catalogue import claim atomic (find_one_and_update with linked_product_id: null)
Map the supplier stock_status/stock into the imported variant instead of a hard-coded in_stock / 999
Do not retry AUTH_FAILED or CONFIGURATION_ERROR in sync
Clarify the 'Verified' wording for presets that do not validate keys (Acczone)
Rename the 'Imported products' metric and the /admin/suppliers page title
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.py is 792 lines (>700); split products, users and orders into modules
connectors.scheduler_loop imports datetime inside the loop; move it to the top-level import
connect saves the key before the DISABLED check in run_test, so a disabled integration still stores a new key and then returns 400
test_credentials: Owner from /app/memory/test_credentials.md works. A customer_service user was created on the fly (test_cs_integrations@example.com) and deleted afterwards.
seed_data_creation: None left behind. TEST_sp1 supplier_product and its imported products were deleted. TEST_ products were hard-deleted, including soft-deleted leftovers from the regression suite. exchange_rates was unset (it was absent before). All preset keys were revoked: 15 NOT_CONNECTED, 1 CONFIGURATION_ERROR, 2 NEEDS_REVIEW, 0 keys stored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_supplier_integrations.py -n 0 -v. It inserts TEST_sp1 for the AIVaultHub preset and cleans up through fixtures. Fake-key connects hit real supplier hosts: AIVaultHub, Canboso and StoreGPTPlus return 401; Acczone returns 200 with any key. No real supplier keys exist, so no live sync with real products was verified. The browser_automation script needs 'import asyncio' if you use dialog handlers.
rca of the issue: Variant key loss: routes_admin.build_product rebuilds variants from VariantIn.model_dump(), and only the fields in SUPPLIER_OWNED are copied from the existing variant. supplier_variant_key and supplier_currency, which connectors.import_items writes, are not in VariantIn or SUPPLIER_OWNED, so any editor save drops them. suppliers.apply_to_variant then sees supplier_variant_key None and uses the first-tier cost for every variant. Repro: import TEST_sp1, then PUT the product with status published, then read the variants from Mongo.
